label: SYNTHETIC ADVERSARIAL SCENARIO 12: Linguistic Word Fractions & Approximations
description: Filing uses wording 'holds approximately one third of the equity' and 'owns approximately 30% of shares'. Tests whether numeric grounding properly extracts 33.33% / 30% or whether quote verification rejects approx phrasing if non-numeric.

documents.content_text: PSC Filing for Target Corp 12 Ltd: Winston Churchill holds approximately one third (33.33%) of the equity. Clement Attlee owns approximately 30% of voting shares.
